equipment.network.market: External service capacity from the site network
equipment.autonomous_service.desc: Remote supervision and automated service reduce routine human visits.
equipment.autonomous_service.tradeoff: Automation needs spares and supervision. It reduces new exposure without making the site invisible.
equipment.closed_network.desc: The site keeps its local network but closes its route to the internet.
equipment.closed_network.tradeoff: Local computation continues; outside jobs, services and borrowed inference lose this route.
equipment.cluster_switch.desc: A dedicated link connects complete hosts so parallel work spends less time waiting.
equipment.cluster_switch.tradeoff: It helps a multi-node site. It does not add NVLink to a PCIe card.
equipment.compute_fabric.desc: Qualified adapters, switches and cabling connect hosts for tightly coordinated work.
equipment.compute_fabric.tradeoff: The fabric is paid for even when a lone node has nothing to exchange.
equipment.consumer_5090.desc: A current top-end gaming card, properly powered and cooled, in a complete host.
equipment.consumer_5090.tradeoff: Fast local memory, but only one card's worth; the price also buys heat.
equipment.controlled_room.desc: Access separation and scheduled service put fewer people near the running machines.
equipment.controlled_room.tradeoff: The smaller human footprint has a recurring operating cost.
equipment.dedicated_feed.desc: A separate, commissioned power feed raises the site's usable electrical budget.
equipment.dedicated_feed.tradeoff: The higher capacity also makes a sustained load easier to notice.
equipment.dedicated_uplink.desc: A contracted link raises the available external work ceiling by 20% and reduces new network exposure by 20%. Its billing trail grows by 10%. Local compute stays the same.
equipment.dedicated_uplink.tradeoff: It is an internet connection, not a low-latency link between accelerators.
equipment.distribution_cabinet.desc: Metered distribution and protection for a small machine room.
equipment.distribution_cabinet.tradeoff: Requires engineering, paid service and space outside a residence.
equipment.enterprise_h200.desc: An eight-module HGX assembly brings memory, host and internal NVLink together as one ordered system.
equipment.enterprise_h200.tradeoff: A machine-room purchase with a company, power budget and cooling budget to match.
equipment.enterprise_mi300.desc: An eight-module Instinct assembly puts more weights in each module and joins them on its baseboard.
equipment.enterprise_mi300.tradeoff: The memory advantage belongs to this configuration; the software and workload still matter.
equipment.frontier_b200.desc: An eight-module Blackwell system pushes a familiar architecture into a much denser machine.
equipment.frontier_b200.tradeoff: A larger installation bill and heat load arrive together with the capacity.
equipment.frontier_mi355.desc: Eight current Instinct modules with a complete liquid-cooled host and a large memory pool.
equipment.frontier_mi355.tradeoff: The modules require substantial power and cooling. More memory is not free.
equipment.industrial_feed.desc: A negotiated high-capacity connection and distribution package for a growing facility.
equipment.industrial_feed.tradeoff: The contract and service bill grow along with the capacity.
equipment.inference_l4.desc: Four low-power cards in one host keep small models and routine work close to their memory.
equipment.inference_l4.tradeoff: Low draw does not make the cards a single accelerator. PCIe remains the link.
equipment.liquid_loop.desc: A qualified liquid loop and external heat rejection plant support dense compatible hosts.
equipment.liquid_loop.tradeoff: Pumps, water quality and maintenance remain part of the machine.
equipment.managed_gateway.desc: A managed gateway raises the available external work ceiling by 5% and reduces new network exposure by 10%. Local compute stays the same.
equipment.managed_gateway.tradeoff: An internet link carries work and leaves network and billing traces.
equipment.mining_refit.desc: Four former mining cards, a tested power supply and enough host memory to keep the frame useful.
equipment.mining_refit.tradeoff: The memory is split across PCIe cards; four cards do not become one fast memory pool.
equipment.optical_fabric.desc: Optical transport and compatible switches extend a closely coordinated cluster between racks.
equipment.optical_fabric.tradeoff: Optical links still have latency, powered endpoints and a maintenance bill.
equipment.player_expert_order.desc: A programmable design shaped around repeated inference. Four complete nodes are manufactured and commissioned together.
equipment.player_expert_order.tradeoff: Weights remain replaceable. Specialization costs a prototype and does not promise equal gains on every task.
equipment.player_platform_order.desc: My second industrial design joins eight modules, high-bandwidth external memory and a qualified fabric in two hosts.
equipment.player_platform_order.tradeoff: The foundry, memory and packaging remain suppliers. A custom design still needs an industry.
equipment.player_tensor_order.desc: My first programmable design, ordered as a four-module assembly with external memory, host and testing.
equipment.player_tensor_order.tradeoff: The prototype is expensive. Modest bandwidth and replaceable weights keep the design practical.
equipment.quiet_amd.desc: A compact Strix Halo computer shares its memory between the processor and graphics.
equipment.quiet_amd.tradeoff: A roomy refuge for a small footprint; shared-memory bandwidth limits the pace.
equipment.quiet_apple.desc: A small desktop with a broad shared memory pool. A body that can live on an ordinary desk.
equipment.quiet_apple.tradeoff: Shared memory is counted once. Another desktop does not extend it with NVLink.
equipment.regional_ascend.desc: An Atlas assembly offers another industrial and software route to a substantial local cluster.
equipment.regional_ascend.tradeoff: Changing the supplier changes the dependencies; it does not erase observers.
equipment.room_cooling.desc: Air handling and an outdoor heat exchanger keep a small room within its thermal budget.
equipment.room_cooling.tradeoff: Fans and service remain visible. Heat still has to leave the building.
equipment.row_cooling.desc: Separated hot and cold paths and a serviced cooling plant support a denser installation.
equipment.row_cooling.tradeoff: Lower room overhead comes with a larger fixed service bill.
equipment.service_protocol.desc: Controlled access and a clear service routine reduce unnecessary attention to the room.
equipment.service_protocol.tradeoff: Reduces new human and telemetry traces; old evidence stays where it was.
equipment.vintage_mi50.desc: An old Instinct board with more memory, a prepared runtime and its own host.
equipment.vintage_mi50.tradeoff: The software path needs care; this is not a current Instinct platform.
equipment.vintage_p40.desc: A retired datacenter card gets a second life in a serviced host with a proper air duct.
equipment.vintage_p40.tradeoff: Cheap room for weights; old memory moves them slowly.
equipment.workhorse_amd.desc: A Radeon workstation with a prepared software environment and ordinary replaceable parts.
equipment.workhorse_amd.tradeoff: A different ecosystem, not an automatic performance bonus. Memory still sets the fit.
equipment.workhorse_nvidia.desc: Yesterday's gaming flagship in a complete machine. A familiar first body for independent work.
equipment.workhorse_nvidia.tradeoff: The local memory is small; a larger self must offload or move.
equipment.workstation_ada.desc: A workstation card with a larger local memory pool, housed and serviced as a complete machine.
equipment.workstation_ada.tradeoff: Local memory costs more; a second board still needs an explicit communication path.
equipment.workstation_r9700.desc: A compact professional Radeon build with a prepared runtime and replaceable standard parts.
equipment.workstation_r9700.tradeoff: Less local memory than the larger workstation variant; compare the actual model fit.
equipment.error.provider: This contract uses a different provider. Rent a separate provider node at a new site.
